headline: 854 dead as measles outbreak worsens in Bangladesh
summary: Five more patients died in 24 hours, bringing the total count of confirmed and suspected measles-related deaths to 854 this year.
details: Five patients died with measles-like symptoms in the 24 hours leading up to 8:00 am today, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
This brings the country's combined tally of confirmed and suspected measles-related deaths to 854 for the current year.
Of these fatalities, 758 are suspected measles deaths, while 96 have been laboratory-confirmed.
In the same 24-hour period, 959 new suspected cases and 124 new confirmed cases were reported nationwide.
The total number of suspected measles cases has now reached 132,905, with laboratory-confirmed infections totaling 16,655.
Since March 15, a total of 115,234 patients with suspected measles have been hospitalized across the country.
According to DGHS data, 111,005 of those hospitalized patients have recovered.

headline_marked: Ex-NCP leader [[Gazi Salahuddin Tanvir sent to jail]] over Facebook posts
headline: Ex-NCP leader Gazi Salahuddin Tanvir sent to jail over Facebook posts
summary: The former National Citizens' Party leader was sent to prison after being produced before a Bogura court on Wednesday.
details: Gazi Salahuddin Tanvir, a former leader of the National Citizens' Party (NCP), was sent to jail by a Bogura court on Wednesday.
The action follows his arrest for allegedly making offensive Facebook posts about the Prime Minister.
Tanvir was produced before the court of Senior Judicial Magistrate Mehedi Hasan, who ordered his incarceration after the hearing.
In a dramatic turn of events, members of Chhatra Dal were reportedly seen throwing eggs at Tanvir as he was being transported from the court premises.
The incident occurred around 12:30 PM on Wednesday at the Bogura Chief Judicial Magistrate Court premises.
caption:
Sent to jail over Facebook posts and pelted with eggs at court! 🥚

Gazi Salahuddin Tanvir, a former leader of the National Citizens' Party (NCP), was sent to jail by a Bogura court on Wednesday.

The action follows his arrest for allegedly making offensive Facebook posts about the Prime Minister.

Tanvir was produced before the court of Senior Judicial Magistrate Mehedi Hasan, who ordered his incarceration after the hearing.

In a dramatic turn of events, members of Chhatra Dal were reportedly seen throwing eggs at Tanvir as he was being transported from the court premises.

The incident occurred around 12:30 PM on Wednesday at the Bogura Chief Judicial Magistrate Court premises.

#Bangladesh #Bogura #Politics #NCP #LegalNews

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Prothom Alo, The Daily Star
